rules: Blockbench is NOT_APPLICABLE for flat icons and ordinary full-cube blocks unless custom geometry materially supports the product.
Every custom geometry source must reopen natively and export twice to normalized equivalent runtime geometry.
Hero and reusable-complex assets require independent Golden scoring; routine assets require originality, readability, and technical validity.
Repairs update editable sources first; export-only hand edits are forbidden.

prohibited: source models, textures, UVs, animations, audio, writing, and branding
private oracle values and hidden cases
clean_room_boundary.proof_rule: Every authoring and product-affecting repair process emits a candidate-bound isolation receipt.

gameplay.controller_conscious_interaction: All primary actions use ordinary item use, block interact, inventory, dialogue forms, or bounded action forms; no keyboard-only requirement.
gameplay.core_gameplay_loop: Gather machine parts, assemble modular devices, establish a paired gate route, deploy one owned guardian, and upgrade a mobile waystation.
crafting_and_loot: survival machine recipes and exact-once upgrade transactions
entities: one mobile machine proxy when active
gameplay.multiplayer_behavior: Travel and guardian targeting are server authoritative; each pair and device is isolated by owner/generation.
gameplay.ownership_rules: Devices and travel pairs have one owner plus an explicit access list.
gameplay.persistence: Versioned pair, destination, device, guardian, upgrade, and migration records.
gameplay.recovery_and_cleanup: Unloaded destinations retain bounded pending travel; destroyed or invalid devices reconcile without orphaned entities.
gameplay.required_original_presentation: Original folded brass, ceramic lens, field-coil, and modular-frame language; no protected brands or source silhouettes.
gameplay.restart_and_reconnect: Versioned state reconstructs idempotently; stale callbacks and generations are inert.

runtime_budget.standalone_policy: A pack may use a larger standalone test fixture only when its assignment declares that fixture; combined integration must meet this reservation target or return an integration finding.

theme: Original shifting machines, paired travel gates, guardian turrets, and mobile waystations.
